meta.title: Repaid In Hate
meta.description: As all eyes watch, the only thing that remains is hatred.

units.rawText: Tartarus Sector, in the Middle Ring.
units.displayText: Tartarus Sector, in the Middle Ring.

spans.text: Tartarus Sector, in the Middle Ring.

units.rawText: Hehehe...
units.displayText: Hehehe...

spans.text: Hehehe...

units.rawText: Lady Malkira granted my request and she even told me not to hold back, teehee~
units.displayText: Lady Malkira granted my request and she even told me not to hold back, teehee~

spans.text: Lady Malkira granted my request and she even told me not to hold back, teehee~

units.rawText: ...It's been several minutes since the transmission ended.
units.displayText: ...It's been several minutes since the transmission ended.

spans.text: ...It's been several minutes since the transmission ended.

units.rawText: Say something, Antenora. I'm worried that if we leave her unattended, this dork will mess around until the Sanctifiers occupy all three Watchtowers.
units.displayText: Say something, Antenora. I'm worried that if we leave her unattended, this dork will mess around until the Sanctifiers occupy all three Watchtowers.

spans.text: Say something, Antenora. I'm worried that if we leave her unattended, this dork will mess around until the Sanctifiers occupy all three Watchtowers.

units.rawText: We just have to kill them all before they activate the Halos, right? Relax, Ptolemaea~
units.displayText: We just have to kill them all before they activate the Halos, right? Relax, Ptolemaea~

spans.text: We just have to kill them all before they activate the Halos, right? Relax, Ptolemaea~

units.rawText: While preparing the scene is more to my preference, a thrilling hunt is good too, right? Even cute little Caina thinks so, too!
units.displayText: While preparing the scene is more to my preference, a thrilling hunt is good too, right? Even cute little Caina thinks so, too!

spans.text: While preparing the scene is more to my preference, a thrilling hunt is good too, right? Even cute little Caina thinks so, too!

units.rawText: Oi spider! Who are you calling cute?!
units.displayText: Oi spider! Who are you calling cute?!

spans.text: Oi spider! Who are you calling cute?!

units.rawText: At least wait until I'm actually gone before talking behind my back! Don't take things too far!
units.displayText: At least wait until I'm actually gone before talking behind my back! Don't take things too far!

spans.text: At least wait until I'm actually gone before talking behind my back! Don't take things too far!

units.rawText: You should tease your enemies, not your allies, Antenora. If you can entropize all those Sanctifiers, I'm sure you'll have far more toys to play with.
units.displayText: You should tease your enemies, not your allies, Antenora. If you can entropize all those Sanctifiers, I'm sure you'll have far more toys to play with.

spans.text: You should tease your enemies, not your allies, Antenora. If you can entropize all those Sanctifiers, I'm sure you'll have far more toys to play with.

units.rawText: I, too, would like more dance partners... If not for our respective circumstances, perhaps I might end up being quite compatible with <cmdr>.
units.displayText: I, too, would like more dance partners... If not for our respective circumstances, perhaps I might end up being quite compatible with {교수}.

spans.text: I, too, would like more dance partners... If not for our respective circumstances, perhaps I might end up being quite compatible with

units.rawText: But you're leaving the VIP seat for me, right? Otherwise I'll get jelly.
units.displayText: But you're leaving the VIP seat for me, right? Otherwise I'll get jelly.

spans.text: But you're leaving the VIP seat for me, right? Otherwise I'll get jelly.

units.rawText: Ahhhh what do you guys mean by toys and seats... Enough with the riddles! I'm going to show Malkira how badass I am when I fight!
units.displayText: Ahhhh what do you guys mean by toys and seats... Enough with the riddles! I'm going to show Malkira how badass I am when I fight!

spans.text: Ahhhh what do you guys mean by toys and seats... Enough with the riddles! I'm going to show Malkira how badass I am when I fight!

units.rawText: Talk about being unable to read the mood... (Sigh) Oh well, let's discuss our battle plan.
units.displayText: Talk about being unable to read the mood... (Sigh) Oh well, let's discuss our battle plan.

spans.text: Talk about being unable to read the mood... (Sigh) Oh well, let's discuss our battle plan.

units.rawText: Our mission is to stop the Sanctifiers from activating the Halo systems in the three Watchtowers. The Sanctifiers will have to split up three ways to keep the Halos running.
units.displayText: Our mission is to stop the Sanctifiers from activating the Halo systems in the three Watchtowers. The Sanctifiers will have to split up three ways to keep the Halos running.

spans.text: Our mission is to stop the Sanctifiers from activating the Halo systems in the three Watchtowers. The Sanctifiers will have to split up three ways to keep the Halos running.

units.rawText: That being the case, the best solution for us is to pick one of the unoccupied towers and lie in wait for them to arrive...
units.displayText: That being the case, the best solution for us is to pick one of the unoccupied towers and lie in wait for them to arrive...

spans.text: That being the case, the best solution for us is to pick one of the unoccupied towers and lie in wait for them to arrive...

units.rawText: Hey! I want a good, clean fight! I don't have time for ambushes and whatever!
units.displayText: Hey! I want a good, clean fight! I don't have time for ambushes and whatever!

spans.text: Hey! I want a good, clean fight! I don't have time for ambushes and whatever!

units.rawText: ...This isn't an ambush, merely picking a suitable plan to suit our strategic objective.
units.displayText: ...This isn't an ambush, merely picking a suitable plan to suit our strategic objective.

spans.text: ...This isn't an ambush, merely picking a suitable plan to suit our strategic objective.

units.rawText: The most suitable plan is beating the crap out of them in a head-on fight! That one from just now wasn't nearly fun enough!
units.displayText: The most suitable plan is beating the crap out of them in a head-on fight! That one from just now wasn't nearly fun enough!

spans.text: The most suitable plan is beating the crap out of them in a head-on fight! That one from just now wasn't nearly fun enough!

units.rawText: Antenora and Ptolemaea exchange looks through their screens. The former shrugs and giggles, the latter sighs in resignation.
units.displayText: Antenora and Ptolemaea exchange looks through their screens. The former shrugs and giggles, the latter sighs in resignation.

spans.text: Antenora and Ptolemaea exchange looks through their screens. The former shrugs and giggles, the latter sighs in resignation.

units.rawText: Besides, Lady Malkira just wants the script to play out. It doesn't really matter how things go, so why not just let Caina handle it.
units.displayText: Besides, Lady Malkira just wants the script to play out. It doesn't really matter how things go, so why not just let Caina handle it.

spans.text: Besides, Lady Malkira just wants the script to play out. It doesn't really matter how things go, so why not just let Caina handle it.

units.rawText: Plus, they've been punished too, right? Some paid with their lives, others accepted the gift. If you divide the remaining Sanctifiers three ways, even Caina should be able to handle them, right?
units.displayText: Plus, they've been punished too, right? Some paid with their lives, others accepted the gift. If you divide the remaining Sanctifiers three ways, even Caina should be able to handle them, right?

spans.text: Plus, they've been punished too, right? Some paid with their lives, others accepted the gift. If you divide the remaining Sanctifiers three ways, even Caina should be able to handle them, right?

units.rawText: The jellyfish girl sighs heavily.
units.displayText: The jellyfish girl sighs heavily.

spans.text: The jellyfish girl sighs heavily.

units.rawText: Caina, what do you want to do?
units.displayText: Caina, what do you want to do?

spans.text: Caina, what do you want to do?

units.rawText: Let's head to the Watchtower that they took!
units.displayText: Let's head to the Watchtower that they took!

spans.text: Let's head to the Watchtower that they took!

units.rawText: Actually, we can ignore that one, as long as we...
units.displayText: Actually, we can ignore that one, as long as we...

spans.text: Actually, we can ignore that one, as long as we...

units.rawText: As long as we get to fight!
units.displayText: As long as we get to fight!

spans.text: As long as we get to fight!

units.rawText: ...Alright, then.
units.displayText: ...Alright, then.

spans.text: ...Alright, then.

units.rawText: Hehe, thanks, Ptolemaea, I was waiting for that!
units.displayText: Hehe, thanks, Ptolemaea, I was waiting for that!

spans.text: Hehe, thanks, Ptolemaea, I was waiting for that!

units.rawText: Beep—
units.displayText: Beep—

spans.text: Beep—

units.rawText: Caina has left the group chat.
units.displayText: Caina has left the group chat.

spans.text: Caina has left the group chat.

units.rawText: ...Huh, so she CAN call people by their names after all.
units.displayText: ...Huh, so she CAN call people by their names after all.

spans.text: ...Huh, so she CAN call people by their names after all.

units.rawText: Antenora, let's pick a Watchtower...
units.displayText: Antenora, let's pick a Watchtower...

spans.text: Antenora, let's pick a Watchtower...

units.rawText: Solitary hunting is more fun, sorry about that, Miss~ Jel~ ly~ fish~
units.displayText: Solitary hunting is more fun, sorry about that, Miss~ Jel~ ly~ fish~

spans.text: Solitary hunting is more fun, sorry about that, Miss~ Jel~ ly~ fish~

units.rawText: Antenora has left the group chat.
units.displayText: Antenora has left the group chat.

spans.text: Antenora has left the group chat.

units.rawText: Be careful, Caina. Stay safe.
units.displayText: Be careful, Caina. Stay safe.

spans.text: Be careful, Caina. Stay safe.

units.rawText: And Antenora, don't call me that.
units.displayText: And Antenora, don't call me that.

spans.text: And Antenora, don't call me that.

units.rawText: Ptolemaea speaks these words into the void, then turns off the equipment and heads toward the remaining Watchtower.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea speaks these words into the void, then turns off the equipment and heads toward the remaining Watchtower.

spans.text: Ptolemaea speaks these words into the void, then turns off the equipment and heads toward the remaining Watchtower.

units.rawText: The Tartarus Sector, in the Middle Ring.
units.displayText: The Tartarus Sector, in the Middle Ring.

spans.text: The Tartarus Sector, in the Middle Ring.

units.rawText: Caina turns a corner and rushes straight toward the Sanctifier-occupied Watchtower.
units.displayText: Caina turns a corner and rushes straight toward the Sanctifier-occupied Watchtower.

spans.text: Caina turns a corner and rushes straight toward the Sanctifier-occupied Watchtower.

units.rawText: 20 minutes, 20 minutes... Jellyfish is great but she just worries too much.
units.displayText: 20 minutes, 20 minutes... Jellyfish is great but she just worries too much.

spans.text: 20 minutes, 20 minutes... Jellyfish is great but she just worries too much.

units.rawText: She's still blowing up my DMs even after leaving the group chat and nagging me about waiting for the Entropics to mob up before entering the Watchtower.
units.displayText: She's still blowing up my DMs even after leaving the group chat and nagging me about waiting for the Entropics to mob up before entering the Watchtower.

spans.text: She's still blowing up my DMs even after leaving the group chat and nagging me about waiting for the Entropics to mob up before entering the Watchtower.

units.rawText: 20 minutes... As if I'd have the mood to fight after that, I'll probably be asleep by then. I just don't get it, what's she so worried about?
units.displayText: 20 minutes... As if I'd have the mood to fight after that, I'll probably be asleep by then. I just don't get it, what's she so worried about?

spans.text: 20 minutes... As if I'd have the mood to fight after that, I'll probably be asleep by then. I just don't get it, what's she so worried about?

units.rawText: Clinkclinkclangclang—
units.displayText: Clinkclinkclangclang—

spans.text: Clinkclinkclangclang—

units.rawText: As the Watchtower's reactivated defenses smite an intruder again for the first time in a long while, their projectiles are all stopped by a single longsword.
units.displayText: As the Watchtower's reactivated defenses smite an intruder again for the first time in a long while, their projectiles are all stopped by a single longsword.

spans.text: As the Watchtower's reactivated defenses smite an intruder again for the first time in a long while, their projectiles are all stopped by a single longsword.

units.rawText: The tightly clustered sounds of metallic impacts are far more shrill than what one might expect, and the shockwaves from their clash level the Entropic architecture around Caina.
units.displayText: The tightly clustered sounds of metallic impacts are far more shrill than what one might expect, and the shockwaves from their clash level the Entropic architecture around Caina.

spans.text: The tightly clustered sounds of metallic impacts are far more shrill than what one might expect, and the shockwaves from their clash level the Entropic architecture around Caina.

units.rawText: Meanwhile, Caina charges through the storm and into the Watchtower.
units.displayText: Meanwhile, Caina charges through the storm and into the Watchtower.

spans.text: Meanwhile, Caina charges through the storm and into the Watchtower.

units.rawText: Aw yeah, that's more like it! Man, that was fun, I haven't had a warmup like that in a while. I'm burning up now.
units.displayText: Aw yeah, that's more like it! Man, that was fun, I haven't had a warmup like that in a while. I'm burning up now.

spans.text: Aw yeah, that's more like it! Man, that was fun, I haven't had a warmup like that in a while. I'm burning up now.

units.rawText: Where's the enemy? Where are the Sanctifiers? I know one of you is still standing guard, so show yourselves!
units.displayText: Where's the enemy? Where are the Sanctifiers? I know one of you is still standing guard, so show yourselves!

spans.text: Where's the enemy? Where are the Sanctifiers? I know one of you is still standing guard, so show yourselves!

units.rawText: Hmm, I wonder who's going to turn up? The one with the bow? The one with the tablet? Or...
units.displayText: Hmm, I wonder who's going to turn up? The one with the bow? The one with the tablet? Or...

spans.text: Hmm, I wonder who's going to turn up? The one with the bow? The one with the tablet? Or...

units.rawText: Crash—
units.displayText: Crash—

spans.text: Crash—

units.rawText: Her longsword cleaves through the wall. An automated defense gun and an optical prism port fall apart in response.
units.displayText: Her longsword cleaves through the wall. An automated defense gun and an optical prism port fall apart in response.

spans.text: Her longsword cleaves through the wall. An automated defense gun and an optical prism port fall apart in response.

units.rawText: Could it be Eos and Eosphorus, the ones they say are the strongest Sanctifiers?
units.displayText: Could it be Eos and Eosphorus, the ones they say are the strongest Sanctifiers?

spans.text: Could it be Eos and Eosphorus, the ones they say are the strongest Sanctifiers?

units.rawText: Hahahahaha, any of them will do, I can't wait!
units.displayText: Hahahahaha, any of them will do, I can't wait!

spans.text: Hahahahaha, any of them will do, I can't wait!

units.rawText: Whoosh—
units.displayText: Whoosh—

spans.text: Whoosh—

units.rawText: There is a sound of an arrow ripping through the air, and a petite figure stands in front of Caina.
units.displayText: There is a sound of an arrow ripping through the air, and a petite figure stands in front of Caina.

spans.text: There is a sound of an arrow ripping through the air, and a petite figure stands in front of Caina.

units.rawText: <size=40>Begone!</size>
units.displayText: Begone!

spans.text: Begone!

units.rawText: Ugh—
units.displayText: Ugh—

spans.text: Ugh—

units.rawText: Tsk, so you're the one who stayed behind to protect this watchtower?
units.displayText: Tsk, so you're the one who stayed behind to protect this watchtower?

spans.text: Tsk, so you're the one who stayed behind to protect this watchtower?

units.rawText: Eh, I guess that works. Better than fighting that <cmdr>, that one doesn't look like they can fight at all.
units.displayText: Eh, I guess that works. Better than fighting that {교수}, that one doesn't look like they can fight at all.

spans.text: Eh, I guess that works. Better than fighting that
, that one doesn't look like they can fight at all.

units.rawText: Judgement Arrow!
units.displayText: Judgement Arrow!

spans.text: Judgement Arrow!

units.rawText: Whoosh—
units.displayText: Whoosh—

spans.text: Whoosh—

units.rawText: <size=40>Clang—</size>
units.displayText: Clang—

spans.text: Clang—

units.rawText: Oi, why the long face? Say something! Don't you guys talk when you fight?
units.displayText: Oi, why the long face? Say something! Don't you guys talk when you fight?

spans.text: Oi, why the long face? Say something! Don't you guys talk when you fight?

units.rawText: I never liked you ranged attackers who shoot people while hiding anyway. A real fight is hand-to-hand and fist-to-fist.
units.displayText: I never liked you ranged attackers who shoot people while hiding anyway. A real fight is hand-to-hand and fist-to-fist.

spans.text: I never liked you ranged attackers who shoot people while hiding anyway. A real fight is hand-to-hand and fist-to-fist.

units.rawText: Whoosh—Clang—
units.displayText: Whoosh—Clang—

spans.text: Whoosh—Clang—

units.rawText: Caina's somewhat exaggerated expression falls, and even her movements slow down a little.
units.displayText: Caina's somewhat exaggerated expression falls, and even her movements slow down a little.

spans.text: Caina's somewhat exaggerated expression falls, and even her movements slow down a little.

units.rawText: Like, why are there people like you? There must be something wrong with your head if you don't enjoy fighting.
units.displayText: Like, why are there people like you? There must be something wrong with your head if you don't enjoy fighting.

spans.text: Like, why are there people like you? There must be something wrong with your head if you don't enjoy fighting.

units.rawText: Ah—I remember now, Jellyfish is just like you, she just can't get into battle. Now, how did I solve that?
units.displayText: Ah—I remember now, Jellyfish is just like you, she just can't get into battle. Now, how did I solve that?

spans.text: Ah—I remember now, Jellyfish is just like you, she just can't get into battle. Now, how did I solve that?

units.rawText: Hm—I think... I think Spider taught me a few ways to taunt people. She said it would help heat up the mood. Yeah, that's what she said.
units.displayText: Hm—I think... I think Spider taught me a few ways to taunt people. She said it would help heat up the mood. Yeah, that's what she said.

spans.text: Hm—I think... I think Spider taught me a few ways to taunt people. She said it would help heat up the mood. Yeah, that's what she said.

units.rawText: Caina's way of speaking grows more and more twisted, to the point where the very air seems to curl up along with her lips.
units.displayText: Caina's way of speaking grows more and more twisted, to the point where the very air seems to curl up along with her lips.

spans.text: Caina's way of speaking grows more and more twisted, to the point where the very air seems to curl up along with her lips.

units.rawText: Now, how should I taunt you? Shrimpy? Or should I call you cowardly, or a wimp, or a piece of worthless trash?
units.displayText: Now, how should I taunt you? Shrimpy? Or should I call you cowardly, or a wimp, or a piece of worthless trash?

spans.text: Now, how should I taunt you? Shrimpy? Or should I call you cowardly, or a wimp, or a piece of worthless trash?

units.rawText: No, you don't care if people look down on you like that. Then what do you care about? What would make you explode with rage?
units.displayText: No, you don't care if people look down on you like that. Then what do you care about? What would make you explode with rage?

spans.text: No, you don't care if people look down on you like that. Then what do you care about? What would make you explode with rage?

units.rawText: Oh, I know. I know, I know, I know what you care about.
units.displayText: Oh, I know. I know, I know, I know what you care about.

spans.text: Oh, I know. I know, I know, I know what you care about.

units.rawText: Caina laughs shrilly.
units.displayText: Caina laughs shrilly.

spans.text: Caina laughs shrilly.

units.rawText: <color=red>At~la~s~</color> Is that it? Hahaha, did I get it right? Was that how you screamed his name?
units.displayText: At~la~s~ Is that it? Hahaha, did I get it right? Was that how you screamed his name?

spans.text: At~la~s~
Is that it? Hahaha, did I get it right? Was that how you screamed his name?

units.rawText: <color=red>Did you know? He was a total mess when he died. I cut him to pieces, and he was still trying to take a stance even though his face was twisted in agony. Man, that was awesome!</color>
units.displayText: Did you know? He was a total mess when he died. I cut him to pieces, and he was still trying to take a stance even though his face was twisted in agony. Man, that was awesome!

spans.text: Did you know? He was a total mess when he died. I cut him to pieces, and he was still trying to take a stance even though his face was twisted in agony. Man, that was awesome!

units.rawText: <size=60>CA! I! NA!!!</size>
units.displayText: CA! I! NA!!!

spans.text: CA! I! NA!!!

units.rawText: Alcyone's chest heaves visibly and her clock speed spikes.
units.displayText: Alcyone's chest heaves visibly and her clock speed spikes.

spans.text: Alcyone's chest heaves visibly and her clock speed spikes.

units.rawText: At the same time, she lets loose even more arrows that streak toward Caina.
units.displayText: At the same time, she lets loose even more arrows that streak toward Caina.

spans.text: At the same time, she lets loose even more arrows that streak toward Caina.

units.rawText: You can't hold it in any more! You're mad! I heard it, I heard all of it!
units.displayText: You can't hold it in any more! You're mad! I heard it, I heard all of it!

spans.text: You can't hold it in any more! You're mad! I heard it, I heard all of it!

units.rawText: Your hardware's in overdrive! Your drive components are humming, your engine is roaring, and that's the way it should be! That's how fighting should be!
units.displayText: Your hardware's in overdrive! Your drive components are humming, your engine is roaring, and that's the way it should be! That's how fighting should be!

spans.text: Your hardware's in overdrive! Your drive components are humming, your engine is roaring, and that's the way it should be! That's how fighting should be!

units.rawText: Caina speeds up, and her longsword stirs up gusts of wind in its wake.
units.displayText: Caina speeds up, and her longsword stirs up gusts of wind in its wake.

spans.text: Caina speeds up, and her longsword stirs up gusts of wind in its wake.

units.rawText: <size=60>HAHAHAHAHA, LET'S ENJOY THIS FIGHT!!</size>
units.displayText: HAHAHAHAHA, LET'S ENJOY THIS FIGHT!!

spans.text: HAHAHAHAHA, LET'S ENJOY THIS FIGHT!!
